$comment: SYNTHETIC DEMO DATA, written for this repository to exercise the pipeline offline. No real organisation is named or implied and no real-world event is described. Rules for anyone adding records: keep the 'replay:' prefix on every sourceName; never attribute a record to a real news agency, government body, or dataset; and remember that the place names are real, so records must never be worded or presented as current reporting.

observations.title: Cargo vessel reports approach by small craft near Bab-el-Mandeb
observations.content: A cargo ship transiting the Bab-el-Mandeb strait reported being approached by two small skiffs before naval escorts intervened. No injuries were reported and the vessel continued its passage.

observations.title: Second outlet reports skiff approach in Bab-el-Mandeb strait
observations.content: Two skiffs approached a cargo vessel in the Bab-el-Mandeb strait earlier today, according to a second wire service. Naval escorts responded and the vessel was not boarded.
observations.$note: Distinct wording and identifier, same underlying event: exercises correlation rather than deduplication.

observations.title: Cargo vessel reports approach by small craft near Bab-el-Mandeb
observations.content: A cargo ship transiting the Bab-el-Mandeb strait reported being approached by two small skiffs before naval escorts intervened. No injuries were reported and the vessel continued its passage.
observations.$note: Byte-identical redelivery of the first record: exercises deduplication.

observations.title: Thermal anomaly detected off the Yemeni coast
observations.content: A thermal anomaly was detected by a synthetic replay of a wide-area thermal sensor. Thermal anomalies have many benign causes and this detection is not evidence of a specific event.
observations.$note: Provider-supplied coordinates, exercising the SourceProvided resolution path.

observations.title: Recorded protest activity in Beirut
observations.content: A structured event record describes a demonstration in Beirut over economic conditions. Crowd size is recorded as moderate and no casualties are listed.

observations.title: Cyber intrusion reported against a regional port operator
observations.content: A regional port operator disclosed a ransomware intrusion that disrupted container scheduling for several hours. Operations were restored from backups and no cargo was reported lost.

observations.title: Report references an unnamed inland location
observations.content: A short dispatch references clashes near a settlement the replay data deliberately leaves unnamed, so that the unresolved-location path is exercised end to end.
observations.$note: The place name is absent from the gazetteer: exercises the unresolved-location path.

observations.title: Naval escort activity recorded in the Gulf of Aden
observations.content: A structured record notes increased naval escort tasking through the Gulf of Aden following recent reporting of approaches to commercial shipping.

observations.title: Structured record of a small-craft approach in the Bab-el-Mandeb strait
observations.content: A structured event record codes an approach by small skiffs to a commercial vessel in the Bab-el-Mandeb strait. Escorts responded and the vessel was not boarded. No casualties are listed.
observations.$note: A third source type describing the event the two wire records already cover: exercises correlation across News and ExternalEvent rather than only between two news outlets.

observations.title: Transit scheduling suspended after advisory from the Northern Transit Council
observations.content: The Northern Transit Council suspended scheduled convoy departures pending a review, according to an invented circular. The notice gives no location and names no terminal.
observations.$note: Deliberately unplaceable: no gazetteer name appears anywhere in the text. Pairs with the next record.

observations.title: Convoy departures suspended pending review, says Northern Transit Council
observations.content: Scheduled convoy departures were suspended pending a review by the Northern Transit Council, a second invented circular reports. The notice again gives no location and names no terminal.
observations.$note: Same event as the previous record, worded differently, and neither can be placed. Exercises the third deduplication layer: correlation on shared actors plus shared wording, which is the only thing that can link these two.
